messages:
Priya: Heads-up — HelixThera (Dedicated migration) hit a warmup failure spike. Can we pivot tomorrow's 15:00 UTC office hours into a focused 45m micro-workshop: 'Dedicated migration troubleshooting'? Quick agenda below, looking for leads and a volunteer to collect reproducible bundles. @here

Ethan: I can take the debug walk-through and show how to read the KV/cache traces. :raised_hands: 

Liam: I’ll cover allocation & quantization checks and a tiny perf test to validate fixes. I have a script we can run during the call.

Sima: I’ll draft the customer note and capture acceptance criteria. Can we keep it 45m (tight) instead of 60m?

Jo: 45m works for me. Also let's record and push a 2-question poll post-session for confidence/readiness.

OpsBot: Event created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/helixthera-micro | 2026-06-10 15:00-15:45 UTC — attendees: Priya, Ethan, Liam, Sima, Jo

Priya: Proposed agenda:
```
1) 5m context + HL of failure pattern (Priya)
2) 20m debug walkthrough: logs & KV inspection (Ethan/Liam)
3) 10m remediation options + config patches (Liam)
4) 5m comms + next steps (Sima)
5) 5m poll + owners (Jo)
```
Drop any must-have items now.

Ethan: Add: how to collect a minimal reproducible bundle. I'll paste `collect_bundle.sh` below during the call.

Priya: Perfect — Ethan please paste snippet here and Jo please draft the two poll questions (1: confident to proceed? yes/no, 2: prefer follow-up session?).

Jo: Poll draft:
1) Are you comfortable with the remediation steps? (Yes / No)
2) Would you like a follow-up deep-dive? (Quick follow-up / Full troubleshooting)
I'll attach after the meeting and share results in thread.

Sima: Also tagging renewal lead @Lena — if remediation looks >1 week we should escalate. Lena, can you stand by?

Lena: Available. If remediation crosses a week we flag for CSM exec touchpoint and update contract readiness.

Ethan: Pre-read I'll paste in thread now:
```bash
# collect_bundle.sh (minimal)
set -e
echo "Collecting KV cache and model load logs..."
mkdir -p /tmp/helixthera_bundle
cp /var/log/redwood/runtime/*.log /tmp/helixthera_bundle/ || true
docker exec -t inference-node tar -czf /tmp/helixthera_bundle/node_state.tgz /var/cache/kv /var/lib/model || true
echo "Bundle at /tmp/helixthera_bundle"
```

Priya: Thanks — final asks: please finalize the calendar invite, attach this snippet as pre-read, and Sima will send the customer note by EOD. :memo: :rocket:
